title: loadpath study
description: A generative design (topology optimization) problem. Units: mm, N, MPa, g/cm³.

name.description: Used to name the output files.

preserve.description: Geometry kept exactly: bosses, mounting faces.

keepOut.description: Volume that must stay empty: bores, bolt access, cables, mating parts.

supports.description: Where the part is held. Required unless every load is a pressure.

open.description: design-space faces left without skin, like '-z' (where ribs stand on a cover's inside)

depth.description: mm the opening is swept inward (a skin and a bit)

openings.description: where the exterior opens into the interior (an underside a flap closes, a port): no skin inside them. The exterior's solid ends at an opening's inner end, and a skin lining that would be a membrane across the cavity behind it

of.description: the exterior the skin lines when the design space is only part of it (a split half): the skin follows it and stops at the cut

thickness.description: mm of skin inside the zone

blend.description: mm over which the thickness ramps across the zone's edge (default 2)

zones.description: places the skin is another thickness, the exterior unchanged: only the inner surface moves (a thinner skin under a touch area so it feels pliable, a thicker one where a rim should be firm)

skin.description: Skin-and-rib: mm of the design space's outer surface kept as a solid wall; the optimizer designs the ribs behind it.

loads.description: Shorthand for a single load case.

material.description: A list solves the goal in each and pools the outcomes.

minMember.description: Thinnest member, mm (default: 2 x the process's minFeature, else 1.4 for the filter).

minHole.description: Narrowest hole or gap, mm (default: the process's minHole, else none). The optimizer pays for the material a hole this narrow would close up with, and the delivered part has it closed.

diameter.description: mm (default SLS 6, MJF 7.5, SLA/DLP 5.5, volumetric 5, LPBF 6.8, else 6)

maxPath.description: mm: more holes while any powder is farther than this from one, through the void (default 60; null: off)

iterations.description: optimizer iterations after drilling, so the design carries load round the holes (default 20)

drains.description: Escape holes into voids the optimizer sealed: 'auto' (default) for powder and resin processes and LPBF, true, false, or options. The holes are drilled where the wall is thin and the strain energy low, then the design re-converges round them.

symmetry.description: Planes through the design-space centre, by normal axis.

keepThinMembers.description: Mesh members one or two cells thick without thinning them (volume-keeping smoothing there, and a debiased stem-smoothing average). Off by default: the default rounding thins them, which the searches are tuned to, but a design made of one-cell walls can come out several times softer than the optimizer's model (the camera boom: 16x).

cutCells.description: Verify on cut cells: each cell the part's surface cuts gets the stiffness of its solid share, stress is read on the true surface, and members under 3 cells thick get a finer submodel. Member thickness then no longer rounds to whole cells (a 2-cell member at 45 degrees read bending 25% low), and a sub-cell strut is seen at its true thickness (the robot arm's wrist link: whole cells read SF 2.28 where 0.9 mm tets read 0.66, cut cells 0.67). On by default, except for studies with pressure loads; false for whole cells.

pitchStarts.description: Searches run on this many grids 1% apart in pitch, keeping the lightest passing part: one grid's result can swing 25-140% with a 1% pitch change. 'auto' (default): 3 for safety-factor and deflection searches up to 30k cells with no pitch given, else 1.

gravity.description: m/s², the part's own weight in every load case

vibration.description: The part's natural frequencies, held above a floor (nTop's natural frequency constraint): the delivered part's first mode, clamped at the supports, with the carried masses, must reach minFrequency. The search counts it with the safety factor and deflection; with masses, the optimizer also stiffens the part against them shaken along each axis (inertial load cases). Needs safetyFactor or maxDeflection in the goal.

minFrequency.description: Hz the first natural frequency must reach

items.description: A carried mass (a motor, a gripper, a battery) on A 'region' (a preserve or keepOut id, or one a fastener adds such as 'w1-bore') or an inline 'shape'.

inOptimizer.description: add the masses' inertial load cases to the optimizer (default true; false: only the check)

inertiaRelief.description: A part nothing holds (a drone arm, a dropped or thrown part): no supports; its own inertia balances each case's loads (inertia relief) and a 3-2-1 hold that takes nothing keeps it still. Not with gravity, thermal or loads of unknown direction.

massProperties.description: Mass properties (nTop's mass, centre of mass and moment of inertia responses): every report gives mass, centre of mass and the inertia tensor (report.massProperties). With an axis the part turns about (a robot link's joint), the optimizer weighs each cell's inertia about it into its cost (inertiaWeight), and maxInertia caps the delivered part's inertia about it.

axis.description: the axis the part turns about (mm)

maxInertia.description: kg mm^2 about the axis, held by the search

inertiaWeight.description: share of a cell's cost in the optimizer that is its inertia about the axis rather than its volume (default 0.5 with an axis): material near the axis comes cheaper

target.description: mm [x, y, z]; null leaves that axis free (balance over a z axis: [0, 0, null])

tolerance.description: mm each held axis may be off (default 1)

centerOfMass.description: where the part's centre of mass must sit (a handheld that balances in the hand, a rotor, a part on a gimbal): the optimizer pulls it there and the report checks it

thermal.description: Heat in the part, applied in every load case: the temperature is solved on the part itself (conduction through the material, convection off its surface), each cell softens by the material's modulus retention at its temperature, and expansion that the supports or the part's own cooler material stop becomes stress. The optimizer designs for it and verification checks it (stress with the free expansion taken off, strength derated as the modulus is). Needs a way for heat out: a fixed temperature or convection.

stressFree.description: C at which the part fits without stress, e.g. when bolted up (default ambient).

temperatures.description: Surfaces held at a temperature: a motor face, a heated bed, a cold plate. A 'region' (a preserve or keepOut id, or one a fastener adds such as 'w1-bore') or an inline 'shape'.

heat.description: Heat flowing in. A 'region' (a preserve or keepOut id, or one a fastener adds such as 'w1-bore') or an inline 'shape'.

spread.description: 'surface' (default): through the region's surface nodes; 'volume': generated in the region's cells (a coil, a resistor potted in).

anyOf.description: W/(m² K) off every exposed surface

h.description: W/(m² K): ~5-10 still air, 20-50 a fan, 500+ water

convection.description: Heat carried off the surface the design exposes (default 8 W/(m² K), still air). An entry without region or shape covers every surface.

conductivity.description: W/(m K) override (default the material card's).

expansion.description: true (default): the material card's expansion coefficient; a number: 1/K (e.g. 7e-5); false: temperature softens the part but does not grow it.

soften.description: true (default): moduli and strength fall with temperature (the material card's retention curve).

specificHeat.description: J/(kg K) override (default the material card's); with the density it sets how fast the part heats and cools in a cycle.

cycle.description: A duty cycle instead of steady heat: the heat inputs are on for the first 'on' seconds of every 'period'. The repeating temperature cycle is solved; the part is designed for its hot moment, checked at its hot and cold moments, and each cycle counts toward thermal-cycling fatigue (durability).

on.description: s the heat is on in each cycle (less than period)

cycles.description: cycles over the part's life, for fatigue (e.g. 3e4: ten a day for ten years)

fatigueWeight.description: How much the optimizer also designs against the hot-to-cold swing (thermal-cycling fatigue): a p-norm of the swing's stress over strength retention, weighted against the hot moment's objective at the start. 0 (default): hot moment only. Experimental: it helped the motor mount at 12k cells but not at 45k, so verify the result. Adding material does not help thermal cycling (stiffer parts hold more expansion).

fatigueSafetyFactor.description: Design against thermal-cycling fatigue as a constraint: the optimizer (MMA) holds the hot-to-cold swing's stress under the material's fatigue strength at `cycles`, over this safety factor, while it minimizes the hot objective. Needs cycles; not with fatigueWeight. Experimental: motor mount at 12k cells, SF 3.5 took the verified fatigue SF 2.67 -> 3.00 at equal hot SF, but at 45k it came out lower (2.45 -> 2.05), so verify the result.

printDirection.description: The direction layers stack; turns on overhang control.

extrusion.description: The part is a profile extruded along this axis (cut from plate).

maxMember.description: Thickest member, mm (at least 2 x minMember): thick members hollow out or split.

axes.description: 2.5: flat pocket floors every stepDown; 5: 3+2 positional, all six sides

directions.description: sides the cutter comes from, like '+z' (default +z; all six for 5-axis)

toolDiameter.description: mm, smallest cutter: narrower slots and tighter inside corners are filled

roughingRate.description: cm^3/min removed with a 10 mm end mill

stockMargin.description: mm of stock past the part on every side

rates.description: Overrides for the machining time and cost estimate (defaults per material family).

milling.description: The part is machined: every void reachable by a cutter coming straight in.

sides.description: 2 (default): halves pull both ways along the draw; 1: one half pulls off a flat parting plane

draft.description: degrees of draft on every wall (1-3 die casting and molding, 3-5 sand): applied to the delivered part and checked facet by facet

parting.description: two-sided: the parting plane's coordinate along the draw axis, mm (default: the widest section)

casting.description: Cast or molded: no undercuts along the draw direction.

methods.description: manufacturing methods to solve for (default fdm, mjf, sla, lpbf, cast, milled-3axis)

materials.description: library materials (or custom ones); each runs on every method its card says makes it (default: one per method)

routes.description: method/material pairs outright (instead of methods x materials)

quantity.description: parts ordered: tooling and set-ups are spread over them

draw.description: cast: the mold's draw (default the design space's thinnest axis)

millingDirections.description: milled: sides the cutter comes from (default both ends of the thinnest axis; 5-axis all six)

screen.description: every route on the coarse grid first, full runs only for the Pareto fronts and top of the ranking

refineTop.description: screen: also refine this many of the top-ranked (default 2)

shareDesigns.description: routes of one method reuse each other's designs (default true)

explore.description: `loadpath explore`: solve the study once per manufacturing method and material, with cost and lead time, ranked (explore.py). `run` ignores it.

switch.description: `loadpath switch`: a target-force push pad (switch.py). Minimize volume so a press anywhere on the touch area fires a switch under the output at a chosen force: a ceiling (any gradient) and a floor per press point, with optional press travel, skin clearance and hold cases. Pair it with `skin` so the exterior is kept as a thin cosmetic layer and the rest is design space. `run` ignores it.

region.description: the plunger face: a preserve id

gap.description: mm, plunger to switch stem at rest

travel.description: mm, the switch's own travel to the click

bearsOn.description: what the switch body sits on, so its give counts in the fire force (default: rigid ground). region/shape: the seat in this mesh (a preserved flap or boss): the closure is the plunger's travel less the seat's. part: a separate fixed part (a flap standing on the desk), its seat's compliance solved on its own on cut cells. compliance: a measured one, mm/N. Any may be combined

supports.description: where the part is held (its foot on the desk)

max.description: one value, or [at the centre, at the radius]: a radial gradient

field.description: press points on rings round a centre, with a radial force gradient

maxTravel.description: mm of press travel at the click (crispness)

clearance.description: how far the skin and interior may move toward what is under them at the fire force: one entry, or one per component (each node gets the room to the component under it)

maxDeflection.description: mm, force-weighted mean travel under the case

hold.description: load cases (squeeze, drop) whose deflection is capped: the shape holds

pitches.description: coarse to fine grids, mm; each starts from the last one's design

nonlinear.description: re-read one press per distinct target with large deflections (default true; about half a minute a press on a 48k-dof push pad with PARDISO, loadpath[fast])

nonlinearPitch.description: mm grid of the large-deflection check (default the first pitch); the design is read onto it

minWall.description: mm, the thinnest skin the designer will accept (default: the process's or material's minimum wall, else minMember)

radii.description: mm, the local skin changes tried round each press (default [4, 8])

gridCheck.description: read the bare skin and the delivered mesh on cut cells (switch_lattice.readback; skinReview.grid.check) and lead the summary with that. Default: whenever the skin is a density floor or the pitch is over 0.75x the skin or minMember, at half the thinner of the two; a number sets the cut-cell pitch, false skips it

skinReview.description: report skinReview (default true): every press the fixed exterior keeps out of its window, where, by how much, and the skin thickness, local skin change or target change that would fix it. Suggestions only: the exterior is never edited. `loadpath switch --skin-review` reads the bare skin alone, before designing

lattice.description: a graded lattice inside the skin instead of ribs (switch_lattice.py, `loadpath switch --lattice`): one cell size, its wall or strut graded per cell to hit each window, then read back on the printable mesh (cut cells) and the windows corrected by that reading for the next round

type.description: a TPMS sheet (gyroid, diamond, schwarz-p) or a strut cell (octet, bcc, kelvin, ...)

wallMin.description: mm, thinnest wall or strut (default minMember)

mode.description: fill: lattice in the whole interior, only its density graded; where-needed: also where there is lattice at all (default fill)

gradeRadius.description: mm, how fast the density may vary (default half a cell)

regionRadius.description: mm, where-needed's presence filter (default 0.75 cell, so a lattice region is about a cell across)

readbackPitch.description: mm grid of each round's read-back (default 0.5)

finalPitch.description: mm grid of the final read-back (default readbackPitch)

feel.description: `loadpath feel`: design the inside of a fixed exterior for how it feels (feel.py). Minimum volume, with each target a stiffness window between where it is held and where the load comes in: `touch` (a zone of the exterior under a fingertip: pliable, firm, or a window; `contrast` sets how distinctly zones differ; `skinThickness` thins the skin under a zone), `squeeze` (a grip gives `travel` mm at `force` N), `drop` (a part of `kg` dropped `height` m sees under `maxG` and moves under `maxTravel`), `isolate` (handling vibration from `band` Hz up reaches a part at under `maxTransmissibility`, a soft mount; or its resonance stays over a handling band `upTo` Hz, a stiff one). Pair it with `skin`; a `switch` block in the same study is designed together with it. A study with a feel block needs no supports or load cases. `run` ignores it.

name.description: touch: the zone's name, as `contrast` refers to it

region.description: a preserve or keep-out id (`skin` is the exterior skin)

face.description: the exterior facing this way: the outermost node of every column

within.description: with a shape alone: the part within this many mm of the shape (where a component touches it: a board's rails, stops and boss)

hold.description: squeeze, isolate, touch: where the product is held (all three directions; touch default: the face opposite the press)

region.description: a preserve or keep-out id (`skin` is the exterior skin)

face.description: the exterior facing this way: the outermost node of every column

within.description: with a shape alone: the part within this many mm of the shape (where a component touches it: a board's rails, stops and boss)

direction.description: squeeze, touch: the press direction (touch default -z); drop: the fall direction (default: toward the landing face)

force.description: squeeze: N the hand presses with; touch: N of a fingertip press

travel.description: squeeze, touch: mm it gives at `force`, [min, max]; {max} alone is a firmness floor (at least `force` N to push it that far)

stiffness.description: squeeze, touch: N/mm, in place of force and travel

zone.description: touch: the place on the exterior (fingertip presses are sampled where a press along `direction` meets the part inside it)

feel.description: touch: a preset window under a 4 mm-radius fingertip: pliable 1-4 N/mm (a 2 N touch sinks 0.5-2 mm), firm >= 15 N/mm (a 5 N press moves it under 0.33 mm), rigid >= 50 N/mm; stiffness or force/travel override the side they give

fingertip.description: touch: mm radius of the pressed disc (default 4)

inset.description: touch: sampled presses are at least this far inside the zone's edge, mm (default half the fingertip, at most a quarter of the spacing)

points.description: touch: the presses, in place of sampling the zone (2 coordinates across the press direction, or 3)

skinThickness.description: touch: mm of skin under the zone, the exterior unchanged (skin.zones); "auto": the thickest skin whose bare presses sit under 0.75 of the ceiling, never under the process's minimum wall (flagged when the zone would need less)

skinBlend.description: touch: mm the skin's thickness ramps over at the zone's edge (default 2)

region.description: a preserve or keep-out id (`skin` is the exterior skin)

face.description: the exterior facing this way: the outermost node of every column

within.description: with a shape alone: the part within this many mm of the shape (where a component touches it: a board's rails, stops and boss)

face.description: the exterior facing this way: the outermost node of every column

within.description: with a shape alone: the part within this many mm of the shape (where a component touches it: a board's rails, stops and boss)

anyOf.description: where: a region, a shape, or an exterior face; a region or a face with a shape too is only the part of it inside the shape (the skin where the hand is)

region.description: a preserve or keep-out id (`skin` is the exterior skin)

face.description: the exterior facing this way: the outermost node of every column

items.description: where: a region, a shape, or an exterior face; a region or a face with a shape too is only the part of it inside the shape (the skin where the hand is)

mass.description: drop: the part to cushion (its mount; a list: every place it is held)

region.description: a preserve or keep-out id (`skin` is the exterior skin)

face.description: the exterior facing this way: the outermost node of every column

within.description: with a shape alone: the part within this many mm of the shape (where a component touches it: a board's rails, stops and boss)

items.description: where: a region, a shape, or an exterior face; a region or a face with a shape too is only the part of it inside the shape (the skin where the hand is)

mount.description: isolate: the mount of the part to keep vibration from (a list: every place it is held, e.g. rails and a boss on a lid)

rigid.description: drop, isolate: the part is stiff next to its mounts (a circuit board, a battery, a capsule), so every place it is held moves with it: its stiffness is the sum of its holds', not their average (default false: the load spread evenly)

maxG.description: drop: peak deceleration of the part, in g

maxTravel.description: drop: mm the part may move before it hits something; isolate: mm under a `shockG` knock

band.description: isolate, soft mount: Hz, the lowest frequency to isolate

upTo.description: isolate, stiff mount: Hz the handling band reaches; the part's resonance is kept over it

maxAmplification.description: isolate with upTo: largest amplification in the band (default 1.25)

shockG.description: isolate: the knock `maxTravel` is read at, in g (default 1: its weight)

ratio.description: the firmer zone's softest press over the softer zone's stiffest (default 2)

contrast.description: touch zones that must feel distinctly different: every press in `firmer` at least `ratio` times as stiff as every press in `softer`

skinPitch.description: mm grid an auto skinThickness is chosen on (default the first pitch, at most 0.5)

lossFactor.description: material loss factor for isolate (default modal.LOSS_FACTOR)

verifyPitch.description: mm grid the delivered mesh is read back on (default half the design pitch: members one design cell thick)

keepThinMembers.description: mesh without thinning one-cell members (default true)

cutCells.description: read the delivered mesh with cut cells, each cell the surface cuts integrated over its solid part (default true; false: as a density, cell fill at E x^3)

moveSharp.description: MMA move limit once the projection is fully sharp (default 0.03)

robust.description: read each floor on the eroded design and each ceiling on the dilated one, so the printed part meets both (default true; false: the blueprint alone, faster, can meet soft windows with grey cells that print as nothing)

pitches.description: coarse to fine grids, mm (used when there is no switch block)

normal.description: the way the cover comes off: an axis like '+z', a vector (an angled cut), or 'auto' (default: tries x, y and z and makes the half holding the components the base; with a seam, the seam's own plane)

at.description: the cut's level along that normal (mm; n.x = at for a vector); omitted: searched
the cut's level over this step (mm, as `at`)

where.description: where the step is: the cut takes this level wherever a line along the normal passes through this shape

steps.description: a stepped parting line: the cut sits at `at`, and steps to each step's level over its `where` (needs normal and at)

stepWidth.description: mm the cut takes to climb a step (default 0.5)

points.description: the parting line on the exterior, in order round the part (closed)

seam.description: a parting line that follows the designer's line on the exterior: the cut passes through these points and is smooth inside (it is never seen). Any line the cover can lift off from along the normal

avoid.description: surfaces the seam must not cross (the designer's A surfaces)

hidden.description: where a seam is not seen (an underside, inside an opening): seam there counts a quarter of its length in the search, as seam in a crease does

search.description: with no `at`: 'all' (default) tries flat cuts across x, y and z, then tilted planes, stepped lines (over or under each part a cut runs through, round each `avoid`), the silhouette and creases in the exterior from the best of them; 'flat' the axis planes only

componentsIn.description: which half holds a component (default: the one most of it is in)

assembly.description: component ids in the order they go in (default: as listed)

clearance.description: mm between mating faces of the lip and the snaps as built (default: 0.2, FDM 0.25, or wider where the process band needs it); drawn wider by the process's gap bias

margin.description: mm from any component to a joint (default 0.5)

stackup.description: how the joints are sized against the process's tolerance band (fits.HOLES, or a calibrated card): 'rss' (default, root sum square) or 'worst' (every face at its limit at once); the report gives both

pathTolerance.description: mm of interference allowed on a component's way in (default 0.25)

lip.description: the alignment lip: a tongue on the base standing up inside the cover's wall (height default 2 mm, width default max(minMember, 1.2)); false: none

from.description: the base's far face the screws go in through: the designer allows the holes

insert.description: heat-set insert OD (mm); else a tapped hole

screws.description: screw posts: a bore up through the base, the head in a counterbore inside the exterior, a thread in the cover; each hole is reported in exteriorChanges. Default: none

on.description: the half the hooks hang from

returnAngle.description: 90 (default): holds until it breaks; lower: comes apart at `pull` N

repeated.description: opened and closed often: 60% of the strain allowance

snaps.description: cantilever snaps, sized so the strain as the barb passes the ledge is within the material's allowance. Default: on (auto count) when there are no screws

split.description: `loadpath split`: cut the exterior into a base and a cover with a lip, screw posts and snaps inside the skin (shells.py; `loadpath schema split`). `run` refuses a study that still has one: split it first and run each half

cooling.description: `loadpath cooling`: design the inside of a fixed exterior around the heat its parts make (cooling.py). Minimum volume, with each component's hottest point under its `maxTemp` and the touched skin under `skin.maxTemp` (or a `skin.contact` class): the interior grows pads and ribs that carry heat to the skin and spread it. Enclosed air conducts (still air in gaps of a few mm), the outside loses heat by natural convection and radiation, and vents the exterior already has carry heat by stack flow. Pair it with `skin`; `switch` and `feel` blocks in the same study are designed together with it. A study with a cooling block needs no supports or load cases. `run` ignores it.

ambient.description: room temperature, C (default 25; 35 for a hot day)

items.description: A part inside that makes heat or carries it: a keep-out `region` (the part as drawn, not its assembly path) or its own `shape`.

region.description: the keepOut (or preserve) id of the part

watts.description: heat it gives off, W (default 0: it only conducts, a battery or a board)

maxTemp.description: C its hottest point must stay under (a die's junction limit less the package's own rise, a battery's 45-60 C)

conductivity.description: W/(m K) (default 20: a package on a copper-filled board)

heatCapacity.description: J/K it holds per K, for a `cycle` (default 1.8 J/(cm^3 K) times its volume; a battery is its mass times about 1000 J/(kg K))

maxTemp.description: C the touched surface must stay under

contact.description: instead of maxTemp: plastic touch limits after IEC 62368-1 (43, 48, 60 C)

shape.description: where it is touched (default: all of the outside)

h.description: W/(m^2 K) to the room, convection and radiation (default 10)

conductivity.description: W/(m K) of the air inside (default 0.03)

shape.description: an opening the exterior already has

area.description: open area, mm^2 (default: the outside faces it covers)

vents.description: openings for stack flow: the lowest let air in, the highest out

gravity.description: the way down in use, for the vents' stack (default -z)

conductivity.description: W/(m K) of the printed material (default the material card's)

cycle.description: Power over time instead of a steady state: the limits hold at each point's hottest moment. A burst after idling, charging, a duty cycle (`repeat`).

watts.description: W per component id in this phase (others keep their `watts`)

start.description: first (default): the steady state of the first phase's power; ambient: cold

repeat.description: the repeating state of the phases, from the mean power

cycles.description: with repeat: cycles run (default 3), the last one read

robust.description: hold the limits on the design eroded and dilated by this much of the projection (true: 0.15; default off)

margin.description: K under each limit the design aims for (default 0): the design grid's error, as the delivered readings on finer grids show it

pitches.description: mm, coarse to fine (without a switch block)

verifyPitches.description: mm grids the delivered mesh's temperatures are read on (default 0.7 and 0.5 of the design pitch)

padGap.description: mm: a gap up to this wide between a component and the delivered plastic is read as the thermal pad (or paste) the model assumes (default 1; 0 reads it as air)

center.description: a point on the axis (default: design-space centre)

pattern.description: Circular pattern: count identical sectors round the axis.

buildDirection.description: the direction layers stack: '+z', a vector, or 'auto'

latticeStiffness.description: printed lattice stiffness over the designed geometry's in the homogenized check: 'as-printed' (default: fitted to 33 published compression tests per process, lattice_print.py), 'designed' (1), or a measured factor

minHole.description: mm: narrowest hole or gap the optimizer may leave (default FDM/SLS/MJF 2, SLA/DLP/LPBF 1, volumetric 0.6)

bridgeSpan.description: mm: longest unsupported bridge the printer prints cleanly (default: 15 FDM, 5 resin, 2 LPBF); longer spans count as needing support

escapeHole.description: mm: smallest powder escape / resin drain hole (default SLS 4, MJF 5, SLA/DLP 3.5)

holeBias.description: mm: as-built minus drawn hole diameter on this printer, measured (default per process in fits.py: FDM -0.2 along the build, -0.35 across; SLS -0.15; MJF -0.1; resin -0.05; LPBF -0.1/-0.2)

holeBiasAcross.description: mm: as holeBias, for holes whose axis runs across the layers (default: holeBias when given, else per process). The calibration kit's H-Z coupon measures it

holeTolerance.description: mm: +- scatter of a hole's as-built diameter on this printer, measured (default per process, growing with diameter)

process.description: How it is made: sets a minimum member, overhang control (FDM, LPBF metal) and the layer-bond check. lpbf = laser powder-bed fusion metal (AlSi10Mg, Ti64, 316L). sls/mjf (PA12, PA11, PA12-GB, TPU) and sla/dlp (resins) get process checks on the delivered part (report 'process': walls, trapped powder or resin, warp-prone panels; resin supports, peel area and suction cups).

enabled.description: auto (default): slice when a slicer is installed; true: warn when none is

executable.description: PrusaSlicer (or SuperSlicer) executable (default: $LOADPATH_SLICER, else found on PATH)

profile.description: PrusaSlicer config .ini (File > Export > Export Config) for your printer's real speeds; relative to the study file

settings.description: PrusaSlicer config keys over the profile, like {"layer_height": 0.25}

supports.description: auto/true (default): the slicer's automatic supports; false: none

infill.description: % infill of the plain slice (default 100: the part is verified solid)

levels.description: infill ladder, sparsest first; solid is always the level above (default [[10,3],[15,3],[25,3],[40,3],[60,3]]: walls that change per region make the slicer run perimeters round each region, inside the part)

collar.description: mm kept solid round preserves, keep-outs, loads, supports (default 2)

grade.description: Size per-region infill density and perimeters from the stress, verified on a homogenized model, and write them as slicer modifiers in a graded 3MF

slicer.description: FDM: slice each outcome headless (PrusaSlicer) for print time, filament and support (report 'slicer'); optionally grade infill by stress (report 'graded', <name>-graded.3mf).

layer.description: mm per analysis layer (lumped real layers; default one voxel)

plate.description: lpbf: mm of build plate modelled under the part (default 10; 0 = rigid)

scale.description: multiplies the inherent strain (a calibration for your machine)

strain.description: inherent strain (exx, eyy, ezz) in the build frame, overriding the material model (negative = shrink)

release.description: full: cut off the plate / peeled off the bed and free (default); none: as built

chamberTemperature.description: fdm: C, air round the part while printing

bedStiffness.description: fdm: N/mm^3 the bed holds the first layer with (default: the value fitted to Armillotta 2018; omit for that)

relax.description: fdm: share of the shrink below Tg kept as stress

bedAdhesion.description: fdm: MPa of bond tension the first layer holds before it lets go of the bed (corners lift and the part re-balances; default: the value fitted to Armillotta 2018)

printLayer.description: fdm: the printed layer height, mm (default 0.2). Warp grows as layers thin, so builds simulated at thicker voxel layers are extrapolated to it; 0 turns that off

plateCells.description: lpbf: voxel layers modelling the build plate, its stiffness scaled to the full plate (default 2; the default k is fitted with it)

recoaterGap.description: lpbf: mm of lift at the build plane that counts as recoater contact risk (default 0.05)

compensate.description: also write <name>-compensated.stl, pre-distorted so the print lands on the design

warpWeight.description: lpbf/fdm: design against build distortion too. The optimizer minimizes compliance * (1 + warpWeight * D / D0), D the mean squared as-built displacement of the layer-by-layer build on the plate (D0 at the start); 0 (default) only verifies. Needs a grid-axis buildDirection. About 1 trades stiffness for a large cut in distortion and recoater lift

warpLayer.description: mm per analysis layer of the warp term (default 4 cells)

maxDistortion.description: lpbf/fdm: a limit, mm, on the largest as-built displacement (on the plate, end of the build). The optimizer holds it as a constraint and the search only passes designs that meet it and the safety factor; report 'warp'. Needs a grid-axis buildDirection

maxRecoaterLift.description: lpbf: a limit, mm, on how far the part rises at the build plane as each layer goes down (the recoater's clearance, ~0.05 mm); held like maxDistortion

brim.description: fdm: brim width, mm (default 0): more bed hold under the footprint's edge (an estimate, not validated)

orientations.description: build directions to try (default the six grid axes)

bedTemperatures.description: bed temperatures, C (default a few around each material's usual)

reoptimize.description: when no outcome passes a warp limit and no setup rescues the shape as it is, re-run the study for the best setup (default true)

printSetup.description: fdm: rank print setups (orientation, material, bed temperature, brim) for the delivered part on strength and warp (report 'printSetup'; printsetup.py)

warpInOptimizer.description: carry maxDistortion / maxRecoaterLift in the optimizer (default true for lpbf; false for fdm, whose limits are checked on each outcome's re-simulated part: in the optimizer they cost strength and did not lower the warp)

warpCoarsen.description: the build model in the optimizer runs on a grid this many times coarser (default 2 on grids of 4000 cells or more, else 1)

buildSim.description: Simulate the build of the delivered part (report 'buildSim'): layer-by-layer inherent-strain residual stress and distortion for lpbf (validated on NIST AM-Bench 2018), fdm warp and bed peel (ABS/ASA/PETG...), sls/mjf differential shrink; optionally a pre-distorted STL.

durability.description: Fatigue (load cases with cycles), creep (with hours) and bolt-preload relaxation, reported under 'durability' in verification. Estimates from published printed-polymer data; see loadpath/durability.py for sources and uncertainty.

safetyFactor.description: Target fatigue/creep safety factor, on the loads (default 1.5; the fatigue curve is already a >90% survival design curve).

constrain.description: true: the safety-factor search also sizes the part for fatigue and creep (default false: report only).

preloadHours.description: Hours fasteners hold their preload, for relaxation (default 8760).

fatigueStrength.description: Override: max stress survived for 2e6 cycles, as a share of the material's strength.

fatigueSlope.description: Override: S-N inverse slope k (life ~ stress^-k).

creepRatio.description: Override: creep strain / elastic strain after 1000 h at 23 C.

type.description: TPMS sheet (default gyroid). Per gram, diamond is the stiffest and strongest, Schwarz P the weakest and has flat ceilings (FDM); lidinoid and split P are finer sheets (twice the surface a cell), Neovius a thick-noded Schwarz P.

cell.description: mm per TPMS period (at least 4 x maxWall)

skin.description: mm of solid shell; 0 leaves the lattice open. Under a skin, SLS, MJF and resin parts get drain holes

sizing.description: homogenized (default): the core is analyzed as the lattice it will be and each cell sized to safetyFactor; solid-stress: graded from the solid part's stress (quick, but not a sizing)

minWall.description: mm, where the part idles (at least the process's minFeature)

maxWall.description: mm; homogenized cells that would need more turn solid

solidAbove.description: (solid-stress) utilization (stress / allowable) above which material stays solid

safetyFactor.description: target safety factor of the lattice walls and skin (default: the study goal's, else 2)

collar.description: mm of solid round preserved shapes, keep-outs, supports and loads (default 2)

blend.description: mm, fillet radius where the lattice meets solid (default maxWall)

drains.description: drain holes into enclosed voids: auto = for powder and resin processes

drainDiameter.description: mm (default the process's escape hole: SLS 4, MJF 5, SLA/DLP 3.5, volumetric 3)

fillPockets.description: mm^3: enclosed voids smaller than this are filled solid (default cell^3 / 8)

lattice.description: Optional: fill the delivered part with a stress-graded TPMS lattice.

multiMaterial.description: Multi-material topology optimization (multimat.py): the optimizer places each material as well as the topology, for multi-material FDM (Bambu AMS, Prusa MMU/XL, IDEX) or jetting. Delivers one body per material with shared interfaces, an STL each and a multi-material 3MF.

materials.description: The materials to place (library names or custom objects).

within.description: near only: limit to inside this region

assign.description: Cells the study fixes to one material (a pad, a bearing seat); the optimizer places the rest. Earlier entries win.

maxFraction.description: material name -> fraction of the part's volume

minFraction.description: material name -> fraction of the part's volume

maxForce.description: N: the peak force it may stop with

safetyFactor.description: the knock's own safety factor: on its stored energy, and on materials and bonds at its peak force (an accidental load; default the goal's / interfaceSafetyFactor)

relativeTo.description: the same force spread out (a case)

atLeast.description: mm the case's load sinks in beyond relativeTo's

requirements.description: Where the part must be soft: a knock that must stop under a force (a bumper), or a patch that must give (a grip pad). These cases are not in the stiffness objective.

interfaceSafetyFactor.description: for the bond between materials (default: the goal's safetyFactor, else 2)

interfaces.description: 'a+b' -> bond strength (MPa), overriding interface_library.py's sourced card (measure your printer's: it varies a lot)

depth.description: mm of interlocking band straddling the interface (default 2)

layerHeight.description: mm per beam layer, instead of layers

gain.description: interlocked / flat bond strength credited (default 2.5 at 2 mm, sourced)

interlock.description: Interlock the materials where they meet (an interlaced beam lattice, as Cura's / Bambu's interlocking beams): the delivered bodies interpenetrate and the bond is credited with the measured gain, capped by what the lattice carries (interlock.py)

bondInTopology.description: experimental: constrain the bond while the layout forms (from projection 4), not only in the final bond stage

interfacePenalty.description: constrain the bond in the optimizer (default true); verification always checks it

assets.description: Eval-only: geometry kept out of this repository (a product's own CAD), read from the directory the environment variable `env` names; the case is skipped without it.

box.description: Box: min/max corners, or center/size (axis-aligned), or center/size/axes (turned: size along the two axes given and their cross product).

axes.description: the box's x and y axes as vectors (its z is their cross product); with center and size

cylinder.description: Cylinder or tube: end points p0/p1, or center/axis/length; radius r, optional rInner.

heightfield.description: One side of a surface given as heights over a plane: the points whose n.x is below (or above) h(u, v), h on a square grid in the plane's axes, bilinear between samples. A stepped or curved parting surface (loadpath split writes these).

axes.description: the plane's u and v axes

heights.description: heights[i][j] = h(u0 + i step, v0 + j step) along normal

mesh.description: A closed mesh: an STL/3MF/OBJ path relative to the study's folder (or a STEP file, .step/.stp, tessellated and healed; needs loadpath[step]), or inline stlBase64.

sdf.description: A sampled signed distance field: an .npz (distance, origin, pitch; mm, negative inside) relative to the study's folder, as loadpath.exterior.save_sdf writes it, or an OpenVDB level set (.vdb, from Houdini, Blender, nTop or `loadpath sdf`). How an SDF tool's shape (libfive, the sdf package, a field graph) comes in.

union.description: Several shapes acting as one region (a servo's four screw bosses).

intersect.description: Where all the shapes overlap: a half ring is a tube intersected with a box.

subtract.description: The first shape with the others cut away: a ring with a gap is a tube minus a box.

shape.title: a shape object (box, cylinder, tube, sphere, heightfield, mesh, sdf, union, intersect, subtract)
shape.description: A shape: box, cylinder (tube), sphere, heightfield, mesh, sdf, union, intersect or subtract. Units mm.

id.description: Name loads and supports refer to.
Name loads and supports refer to.

bore.description: false: a clearance volume (a mating part, a sweep) that may end against material; it is not checked for closed ends. Default true (false for a pressurized cavity).

wall.description: mm of material kept round it, pinned solid: a duct's or a plenum's skin, with only what is behind it designed (ribs). A pressurized keep-out gets minMember if not set.

fit.description: A cylindrical bore's fit against the part that goes in it (fits.py): press (a bearing's outer ring, a dowel pin), transition, slip (a locating pin, a removable shaft), clearance (a shaft turning in it), close/normal/loose (bolt holes, ISO 273), nominal (hold the drawn diameter: the default for every bore once the process is known), none (no allowance). The hole is redrawn for the process's hole bias and report fits gives the as-built band and whether the fit holds.

mate.description: Diameter of the mating part, mm (default the cylinder's: draw the keep-out at the bearing's or pin's size).

anyOf.description: a path of legs as the part leaves its place: every leg but the last with a length; the last goes on out of the design space unless it has one too

insertFrom.description: Assembly path: the side the component (or a tool) comes in from, like '-z', or a vector. The keep-out is swept out of the design space that way, so nothing generated blocks putting the part together (a board slid in from below, a driver reaching a screw).

finish.description: auto (default): ream when the process cannot hold the fit as printed (the hole is drawn undersize for the reamer); as-built: keep the printed hole; ream: always.

support.description: Where the part is held. A 'region' (a preserve or keepOut id, or one a fastener adds such as 'w1-bore') or an inline 'shape'.

fix.description: 'all' (default), 'pin' (a cylinder: turns freely), axes like 'xz', or 3 booleans

maxForce.description: N: the most this support may carry (its reaction's resultant, any case), e.g. a bolt or bearing rating; reported always as report.reactions

maxMoment.description: N·mm: the most moment this support may carry about its centroid

switchClearance.description: a fixed gap for a region ({region | shape, gap}), or the room to a component measured per node along the press ({component, margin}; region/shape then limit which nodes count)

id.description: name in the report (default the component or region)

gap.description: mm the region may move along the press at the fire force

anyOf.description: a keepOut id: its shape before any insertFrom sweep

margin.description: mm kept clear of the component (default 0.1)

reach.description: mm, how far below a node to look for the component (default 10)

load.description: A force (N) and/or a moment (N·mm, about the region's centroid), or a pressure (MPa) in a keepOut. A 'region' (a preserve or keepOut id, or one a fastener adds such as 'w1-bore') or an inline 'shape'.

distribution.description: 'bearing' spreads a force over the half of a bore it pushes on

pressure.description: MPa gauge (1 bar = 0.1 MPa) inside the keepOut named by 'region' (the fluid's volume), on every wall lining it; negative is a vacuum. A study whose only loads are pressures on sealed cavities needs no supports.

direction.description: 'any': the force's size may point in any direction (contact, bumps, handling); the part is designed and checked for the worst one, found exactly from three unit-force solves. At most one per load case; a bearing load's uncertain force is spread evenly over the region. 'xy', 'xz' or 'yz': any direction in that plane (a shaft's radial load, a swinging strap, a sideways crash): the case becomes cases 22.5 degrees apart (within 2% of the worst), named case@angle: eight over half the plane, or sixteen over all of it when -F is not the mirror of F (bearing distribution, other loads, a moment, a layered process); a moment on the same load turns with the force (right when its lever arm is along the plane's normal).

cone.description: Degrees: the force may tilt up to this far from its written direction, and the worst tilt is designed for (180 is the same as direction 'any').

mass.description: kg carried through this region (a payload, the next link, a camera): adds mass x 9.81 x dynamic N along 'gravity', and with 'at' the moment of that force about the region (N·mm), so you never convert by hand.

at.description: mm: where the force acts or the mass's centre sits (default: on the region): a pulley in front of a motor face, a tool's centre of mass. Its offset from the region's centre adds the moment; `check` echoes the resulting force and moment per case.

dynamic.description: Multiplier on the mass's weight: 1 static, 2 a moving robot joint, 3 anything that can be dropped or crash (default 1).

gravity.description: Which way the mass pulls: '-z' (default), or a vector.

cycles.description: Times this whole case is applied over the part's life (set on the case, not a load): adds a fatigue check (e.g. 1e6 for a servo-driven arm).

hours.description: Hours this load is held over the part's life: adds creep rupture and crept deflection.

temperature.description: C while this load acts (default durability.temperature).

anyOf.description: A name: 15-5ph, 304, 316l, 6061-t6, 7075-t6, a356-t6, abs, agilus30, alsi10mg, asa, in625, pa-cf, pa11, pa12, pa12-gb, pa12-gf, petg, pla, pp, resin, resin-rigid, resin-tough, ti64, tpu, tpu88a, vero (aliases such as 'nylon', 'aluminium', 'steel' work; every value is cited in material_library.py, `loadpath materials`), or a calibrated card measured on a printer (loadpath/calibrations/, calibration.py), which replaces a library card of the same name.

A custom material: E (MPa), nu, strength (MPa), density (g/cm³); or "base": a library name and only the values that differ. EZ and strengthZ are across-layer values, used when the study's process is the one named in "measured".

fastener.description: A bolted joint as an interface: bearing rings or a thread sleeve are preserved, the bore and head path kept clear, and a preload case added. Adds regions <id>-bore, <id>-head, <id>-seat, <id>-face or <id>-thread (and <id>-tap).

seat.description: Centre of the face the head (or the mating part) bears on.

direction.description: From the seat into the part, the way the screw goes.

grip.description: mm from the seat to the far end (0 for a thread or insert starting right at the seat).

threadLength.description: end 'thread': engagement length past the grip (default 2x the screw's diameter).

insert.description: Heat-set insert or nut outer diameter, mm; else a tapped hole.

preload.description: N. Default: a quarter of what the seat can bear in this material, at most what a class 8.8 screw is tightened to.

hole.description: Clearance hole diameter, mm (default from size).

head.description: Head (or washer) diameter, mm (default from size: the ISO 4762 socket head, e.g. M3 5.5, M4 7, M5 8.5).

counterbore.description: Diameter of the head and driver keep-out, mm: the counterbore the head sits in (default the seat ring's width, at least head + 1).

diameter.description: The screw's nominal diameter, mm, when not given as size.

wall.description: mm of seat ring beyond the head's radius (default 15% of the diameter, at least 1). The head and driver keep-out is as wide as that ring, at least the head's radius + 0.5 mm.

ring.description: Seat and face ring thickness along the screw, mm (default 40% of the diameter, at least 2). Bosses a brief asks for go in preserve.

sleeveWall.description: end 'thread': wall of the sleeve round the tap, mm.

fit.description: The clearance hole: ISO 273 fine (close), medium (normal, the default) or coarse (loose), drawn for the process's hole bias; nominal holds a given hole.

driver.description: Length of the head and driver keep-out back from the seat, mm (default 60). Shorten it where it would cut through another interface.

goal.description: volumeFraction keeps that share of the design space; safetyFactor and/or maxDeflection search for the lightest part that meets them in every load case.

maxMass.description: g: a cap the delivered part is checked against (deliver.passes is false over it). The search already returns the lightest part that meets the other limits, so over the cap means a lighter material, smaller preserves or a lower safety factor.

confirm.description: How the lightest passing part is confirmed: voxel (a finer voxel grid), tet (a body-fitted tetrahedral mesh, which also calibrates the search's voxel stress so it steps down to the real target), or auto (tet when installed and applicable).

outcomes.description: Extra fixed volume fractions for a trade-off gallery.

restarts.description: Run the safety-factor/deflection search this many times from different starting fractions and deliver the lightest confirmed part (default 1). One search lands in the local optimum its start leads to (7-17% apart in delivered mass on the eval parts); worth it for a final production part, at N times the time.

minimize.description: Which passing outcome is delivered: the lightest (default), or (FDM, with a slicer installed) the one that prints fastest or with the least filament, support included, as sliced (graded, with slicer.grade).

buckling.description: Whether the safety factor must hold against buckling too (default true): the part's linear buckling load factor, on a grid of at most 12k cells, must reach safetyFactor. false still reports it (report.buckling).
